criteria.statement: Nav.svelte replaces the auth-section block with UserMenu without modifying auth store behavior.
Anonymous users can open a Sign In menu with NIP-07 and NIP-46 choices, with NIP-07 disabled when the browser signer is unavailable.
Authenticated users see an avatar/profile pill menu with profile summary, Edit Profile, Manage Relays, auth method indicator, and Logout.
Menu keyboard handling supports ArrowDown, ArrowUp, Home, End, Escape, Tab, and activation by Enter/Space.
At max-width 560px the dropdown renders as a bottom sheet with backdrop and 48px minimum item targets.
